breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions, specifying both Neumann (u_x=0) and Dirichlet (u=0) conditions. The agent correctly identified this conflict and, in alignment with the ground truth, discarded the contradictory Dirichlet condition, proceeding only with the Neumann conditions.
